function.name: self_compact
function.description: Request compaction of this conversation at the end of the current tool round, then resume. Use when resolved investigation or repetitive tool output can be replaced by a substantially smaller record without losing what is needed to continue. Preserve decisions, constraints, evidence references, ruled-out approaches, unresolved hypotheses and next actions in the handoff; retain decision-rich planning and unfinished investigations when their detail still matters. This is a request, not proof that compaction succeeded. Local LiteTUI backends only. Automatic compaction remains the fallback. Do not call again immediately after waking without useful intervening work.

reason.description: What is resolved or redundant, and why a smaller record suffices now.

handoff.description: Concise continuity record: goal, decisions and constraints, findings with evidence pointers, failed approaches, open questions, and next action. Preserved verbatim in the compacted context.
